name: respin
description: re:spin – platform-skelet, UI-kit (@respin/ui), apps (web, admin, showcase) og hjemmeside (site)

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w showcase && npm run build -w site
scripts.dev:showcase: npm run build:ui && npm run dev -w showcase
scripts.dev:site: npm run build:ui && npm run dev -w site
